## Checklist

- [ ] `python -m compileall binscope` passes
- [ ] `pytest -q` passes (tests do not require external RE tools)
- [ ] Added/updated a test that covers the change
- [ ] New findings carry a reproducible coordinate where applicable
- [ ] Change stays within scope (authorized analysis only; no DRM-bypass /
      cheats / evasion)
- [ ] Updated `CHANGELOG.md` under *Unreleased* if user-facing
